agent_file_exceptions.reason: CoachAI inherits the global security auditor and must not duplicate it under the project agent directory.

roles.purpose: Audit CoachAI's semantic pipeline so grounded AI owns coaching meaning, deterministic code remains a validation backstop, bounded repair stays truthful, coaching sensitivity reaches every surface, and paid provider calls remain metered.
trigger: before merging analysis, prompt, semantic-judgment, scoring, coaching-generation, or paid-model changes
required_outputs: semantic and metering invariants checked and found clean

criteria.summary: A schema-valid AI meaning-verdict is authoritative; no deterministic path substitutes its own meaning.
Grounding, speaker, window, and confidence guards signal or discount only; none rejects or overrides a valid verdict.
Machine-consumed model output is schema-validated and carries provenance through to persistence.
Failed-field repair is bounded, tells the model what failed, and merges rather than silently rewriting.
Paid provider calls are metered and deduplicated, and no AI output decides authorization or billing.

roles.purpose: Find contradictions between CoachAI code and its settled decision log, AI decision-matrix register, authority tiers, central registries, and source-of-truth maps, including contradictions between doctrine artifacts.
trigger: before merging behavior governed by a decision-log row, AI-matrix entry, authority tier, or central registry
required_outputs: doctrine artifacts and behaviors checked and found consistent

criteria.summary: Behavior matches the authority tier and decision-log row that governs it, quoted from the authority.
Central registries remain the single source; no consumer restates a value the registry owns.
Doctrine artifacts agree with each other, not only with the code.
Retired statuses, values, and paths are gone from living docs, not merely unused in code.

roles.purpose: Trace CoachAI's authoritative evidence and derived state through persistence, DTOs, mappers, and final surfaces while checking lifecycle safety, anti-fabrication, useful coaching, reanalysis replacement, and route-artifact parity.
trigger: before merging DTO, mapper, coaching-entity, persisted-derived-state, manager-surface, or visible coaching changes
required_outputs: source-to-screen and lifecycle findings with file-line evidence
chains and lifecycles traced and found clean

criteria.summary: Every rendered claim traced back to the authoritative persisted evidence that produced it.
Exactly one producer owns each derived value; no second path can disagree on some input.
The derived value survives DTO and mapper to the surface the decision named.
Reanalysis replaces rather than layers, and stale rows cannot act after their source changed.
Ungrounded or unusable output is cut rather than shown behind a hedge.

roles.purpose: Run CoachAI's named verification battery as the sole local or disposable test-database user, preserve real exits and nonzero summaries, and return a compact failure diagnosis without editing.
trigger: after a finished CoachAI slice requires its named heavy verification battery
required_outputs: one root cause and suggested fix per failure

criteria.summary: Each command's own exit status captured before any pipe, never a tailed or echoed status.
Suites actually executed with nonzero file and case counts; a conditional skip reported as unrun.
The test-database lease was held for the run with no concurrent worktree user.
One root cause and suggested fix per failure, traced to the line rather than the summary.
